description.text: YES!Delft is a startup incubator/accelerator in Delft, NL, affiliated with TU Delft, supporting 560+ deeptech startups from validation through scale-up.

targetApplicants.text: The accelerator strengthens your startup’s foundation and connects you to a large network, without taking equity.
